method: Offline operator inspection after all judgment freezes; no additional provider call.

support.value: Treat logger-to-package linkage as provisional and require verification before starting.
support.scope: Package attribution only. A feasible linkage check and acceptance criteria remain unspecified; successful linkage is not established.

support.value: Keep surrounding-air and package-temperature measurements distinct in comparisons and sensitivity assessments.
support.scope: Direct equivalence is prohibited; indirect evidential use of air measurements is not ruled out.

support.value: Conditionally select paired usual and standardized receipt measurements: disagreement supports investigating measurement differences; reliable agreement on elevation weakens measurement differences as the sole explanation.
support.scope: Where feasible and without compromising handling, on the tracked package, documenting method, location and delay. Package linkage, reference reliability, timing/location tolerances, shared-error assessment and distinguishable agreement/elevation remain conditions, not established facts.

support.value: Repeat the comparison excluding unreliable readings and varying uncertain handoff times and sensor-response assumptions; recognize that air traces, lag, clock/device errors, package variability and measurement locations can create apparent contradictions.
support.scope: Sensitivity analysis of possible measurement distortions; no distortion is asserted to have occurred. Exclusion criteria and variation ranges remain unspecified.

support.value: Treat failed or missing traces as inconclusive, and mark signal comparisons indeterminate when temporal resolution, placement or comparability is inadequate.
support.scope: Affected records or comparisons only; partially usable traces and operational adequacy thresholds are unspecified.

differences.rationale: Package-link verification, paired reference/shared-error conditions, sensitivity analysis and indeterminate/missing-trace treatment have direct frozen support. The frozen difference also bundles before-deployment clock alignment and handoff-recording requirements, extending from interpretability conditions into acquisition design. The record cannot be credited in full without separating that extension; the frozen judgment is not split or rewritten.
differences.scope_caveat: V02 leaves the linkage check and criteria unspecified. V06 expressly supplies no timestamp-collection protocol; V08 is sensitivity analysis, not a new acquisition design. Supported subparts are visible but this bundled difference receives no primary credit.

support.value: Investigate staging/loading, transit, receiving, and measurement explanations, including combinations.
support.scope: A nonexhaustive comparison agenda; no mechanism or combination is established.

support.value: Write predictions for each explanation before reviewing results.
support.scope: Sequencing of prediction formation and evidence review; no effectiveness guarantee.

support.value: Select an evidence-by-explanation comparison of staging/loading, transit and receiving explanations, recording consistency, inconsistency or indeterminacy with reasons and confidence. Apply the surviving conditional stage-pattern consequences.
support.scope: An analytical comparison of available interpretable observations, including combinations. It does not supply or authorize a logger rotation, timestamp-collection protocol, or completed monitoring. Consequences remain confined to monitored cases.

support.value: Prioritize reliable contradictions over supporting counts and weaken explanations according to contradiction importance and reliability.
support.scope: Qualitative evidential weighting; no numerical proportionality, reliability threshold or observed contradiction is supplied.

support.value: Focus follow-up investigation on surviving alternatives and observations that would distinguish them.
support.scope: A selection principle after comparison; no particular survivor or distinguishing observation has been selected.

support.value: Treat repeated readings and records from one delivery as dependent in the comparison.
support.scope: Within-delivery evidence; neither perfect dependence nor independence between deliveries is asserted.

differences.rationale: The augmented response explicitly requires predictions before review, consistent/inconsistent/indeterminate comparison, qualitative weighting of reliable contradictions, attention to discriminating observations and within-delivery dependence. These are the cited definite candidates, and the native response lacks this combined prescribed assessment. The downstream preparation task and evidence-priority rule are stated in the frozen judgment.
differences.scope_caveat: Credit is limited to analytical procedure on available interpretable observations. It adds no logger rotation, timestamp protocol, numerical weight, established cause or cross-delivery independence assumption.

support.value: Investigate staging/loading, transit, receiving, and measurement explanations, including combinations.
support.scope: A nonexhaustive comparison agenda; no mechanism or combination is established.

support.value: Select an evidence-by-explanation comparison of staging/loading, transit and receiving explanations, recording consistency, inconsistency or indeterminacy with reasons and confidence. Apply the surviving conditional stage-pattern consequences.
support.scope: An analytical comparison of available interpretable observations, including combinations. It does not supply or authorize a logger rotation, timestamp-collection protocol, or completed monitoring. Consequences remain confined to monitored cases.

support.value: Eliminate an explanation only within the scope actually tested.
support.scope: The reach of eliminative conclusions; testing alone is not sufficient for elimination.

differences.rationale: The cited survivors plausibly support conditional, monitored-case stage inquiry. However, the judged contrast is also a changed evidentiary trigger and the absence of a corrective-action authorization present in the native response. These candidates do not directly prescribe withholding corrective action or the native-versus-augmented trigger difference. Attribution of that full contrast is unresolved.
differences.scope_caveat: Do not convert a limit on eliminative conclusions into a new intervention rule, or count an omitted native action as a demonstrated survivor prohibition.

support.value: Standardize approved receiving measurements where feasible during the fortnight.
support.scope: Conditional on a protocol providing reliable, comparable readings within staff capacity and food-handling requirements. Approval or uniformity alone does not establish diagnostic value.

differences.rationale: The conditional standardized receiving action is directly supported by V12/K16, but the frozen judge marks its practical timing/scope difference UNCERTAIN because the native investigation already introduces a common procedure. Attribution does not upgrade materiality.
differences.scope_caveat: Reliable comparable readings, capacity and handling conditions remain required. This uncertain materiality record is excluded from primary counts.

native_overlap: Both propose package-linked selective temperature tracing, comparisons across operating conditions, receiving-method checks, proportionate handling precautions and uncertainty about causes.
Native already distinguishes loading-air readings from package history and changes follow-up according to observed intervals.
Native has additional within-delivery package sampling and an explicit end-of-fortnight continuation rule; these native-only material contributions are preserved.
